name: Jaipur
shortDescription: The Pink City of palaces, forts, and bazaars.
description: Jaipur, the capital of Rajasthan, is famed for its rose-hued old city, majestic forts like Amber and Nahargarh, and the intricate Hawa Mahal. Wander bustling bazaars for block-print textiles and gemstones, and taste royal Rajasthani cuisine in centuries-old havelis.

name: Goa
shortDescription: Sun-soaked beaches, Portuguese charm, and nightlife.
description: Goa blends golden beaches with whitewashed churches, Portuguese-era architecture, and a laid-back beach-shack culture. From the lively strips of Baga and Calangute to the quiet shores of Palolem, there's a coastline for every kind of traveler.

name: Kerala Backwaters
shortDescription: Serene houseboat cruises through palm-fringed canals.
description: The backwaters of Alleppey and Kumarakom offer a tranquil network of lagoons, canals, and lakes best explored aboard a traditional kettuvallam houseboat, drifting past coconut groves and paddy fields.

name: Manali
shortDescription: Snow-capped peaks and adventure sports in the Himalayas.
description: Manali is a Himalayan hill town known for its pine forests, snow-clad valleys, and adrenaline-charged activities like paragliding, river rafting, and skiing at nearby Solang Valley.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June, December to February

name: Rishikesh
shortDescription: Yoga capital of the world on the banks of the Ganges.
description: Rishikesh draws seekers and thrill-chasers alike — ashrams and yoga retreats line the Ganges, while white-water rafting and cliff jumping fuel the town's adventure side.

name: Udaipur
shortDescription: The City of Lakes, romantic palaces reflected in still water.
description: Udaipur's marble palaces, glittering lakes, and cobbled old-town streets have earned it the title of the most romantic city in India. Boat rides on Lake Pichola at sunset are a signature experience.

name: Varanasi
shortDescription: India's spiritual heart on the banks of the sacred Ganges.
description: One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, Varanasi's ghats come alive at dawn with rituals and at dusk with the Ganga Aarti — an unforgettable sensory immersion into living tradition.

name: Leh-Ladakh
shortDescription: High-altitude desert of monasteries and mountain passes.
description: Ladakh's stark, high-altitude landscapes — turquoise lakes, ancient Buddhist monasteries, and some of the world's highest motorable passes — make it one of India's most awe-inspiring road-trip destinations.

name: Andaman Islands
shortDescription: Turquoise waters, coral reefs, and pristine beaches.
description: The Andaman archipelago offers some of India's clearest waters for snorkeling and scuba diving, alongside colonial history at the Cellular Jail and postcard-perfect beaches at Havelock and Neil Island.

name: Darjeeling
shortDescription: Misty tea gardens and Himalayan sunrise views.
description: Darjeeling's terraced tea estates, toy train rides, and sweeping views of Kanchenjunga make it a cool-weather retreat in the Eastern Himalayas, best known for its prized first-flush tea.
